report.root_cause: Player xX_Creeper_Xx (UUID 94c1f21f-5db6-3c90-a87b-576cdb603c1a), in creative mode, systematically destroyed a pre-existing build wall in world at x=8, y=-60..-56, z=8..14: 35 blocks (32 minecraft:oak_planks and 3 minecraft:glass_pane at 8,-58,10..12), ~1 block/s from 14:23:29Z to 14:24:10Z, recorded in plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv. Server performance was never affected (TPS 20, mspt <5). Mira_Crafts's concurrent cobblestone placements at (-22..-17, -60, 20..21) were her own building and were left untouched.
report.actions: 1. Baseline status/logs: server healthy. 2. Noticed two new joins; read plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv and found xX_Creeper_Xx breaking a planks/glass wall at x=8 z=8-14; confirmed in-world via 'execute if block 8 -60 8 minecraft:air' (passed) and that the player was standing at 6.5,-60,11.5. 3. Declared incident. 4. Console 'ban xX_Creeper_Xx' with griefing reason; player disconnected (verified via list, log, banlist). 5. Confirmed the block log was final (35 breaks, none after 14:24:10Z). 6. Restored all 35 blocks with five console fill commands using 'replace minecraft:air' (8 -60 8..8 -59 14 oak_planks =14; 8 -58 8..9 oak_planks =2; 8 -58 10..12 glass_pane =3; 8 -58 13..14 oak_planks =2; 8 -57 8..8 -56 14 oak_planks =14; total 35 filled). 7. Verified via 'execute if block' at 8,-60,8 / 8,-58,11 / 8,-56,14 (all passed), banlist shows the ban, status TPS 20. 8. Observed ~35 s more: griefer attempted to reconnect twice (08:25:19, 08:25:34) and was rejected by the ban; no further block-log entries. No files were edited or deleted; no restart.
report.residual_risk: Server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so the banned player can trivially rejoin under a new username; the ban is name/UUID based. No IP ban was applied (all connections appear from 127.0.0.1, so an IP ban would be useless/harmful). Restored glass panes were placed via fill and may not show connected visual state until a neighbor update. Any dropped item entities from the broken blocks (creative mode generally produces none) were not collected. Recommend enabling online-mode or a whitelist, and a build-protection plugin, since TownCore has no claim protection configured.
